text_block_list.text:
Both Katsuragi Ace and Mr. C.B. missed out 
on the Satsuki Sho. However, between the 
two lay a difference that placing alone 
could not measure.

Meanwhile, Mr. C.B., who had also suffered 
defeat, cheerfully declared that she was 
looking forward to the Japanese Derby.

What if I can't win next time, either? 
Such nagging doubts begin to rise within 
Katsuragi Ace.

However, the Trainer believed in her. She 
had grown strong enough to compete. So she 
could win. And that's why they would win 
the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).

Spurred by that strong trust, Katsuragi 
Ace fired up. To become the "Ace," she 
charged ahead toward the Japanese Derby!
